scripts.dev: node scripts/dependencies.mjs && cd client && go run -ldflags "-X main.version=$(node ../scripts/version.mjs show)" ./cmd/passpine
scripts.preview: node scripts/dependencies.mjs && cd client && go run -ldflags "-X main.version=$(node ../scripts/version.mjs show)" ./cmd/passpine --preview
scripts.test:browser: pnpm --dir browser run typecheck && pnpm --dir browser test
scripts.test:tooling: node --test scripts/version.test.mjs scripts/release.test.mjs scripts/release-artifacts.test.mjs scripts/ci-release.test.mjs scripts/package-client-linux.test.mjs scripts/dependencies.test.mjs scripts/update-artifacts.test.mjs scripts/build-channel.test.mjs scripts/install-local.test.mjs
